newsitem.title: USA: Tosco to shut NJ crude units in July--source.
newsitem.headline: Tosco to shut NJ crude units in July--source.

text.p: Tosco Corp's Bayway, New Jersey refinery will shut some of its crude units for three weeks of unscheduled maintenance beginning in mid-July, according to a source familiar with the plant's operations.
The cutback in operations at the refinery, which can process up to 240,000 barrels per day of crude oil, will likely last through the first week of August, the source said.
"It's not a complete shutdown, but it'll be a significant crude cut," the source said.
The company has been buying gasoline to cover its commitments, according to the source.
The refinery is home to the "Gasoline Machine," a 155,000 barrel-a-day catalytic cracker that is the largest in the world.
